title: Payroll
description: Payroll documents by month — automatically calculated based on the timesheet

form.title: New payroll document
form.note: Note: multiple documents can be created for the same month (for example, a separate advance and end-of-month payment) — each time only the remaining unpaid amount is calculated.

list.confirmedDelete: This document is confirmed — deleting it will reverse the money withdrawn from the cash/bank balance.
list.draftDelete: This is a draft document, so there are no money movements.

table.confirmDescription: A total of {amount} UZS will be deducted from the cash/bank balance. This action cannot be undone (it can only be reversed by deleting the document).
